calibrated_validation.description: The weightiest bid — 'It feels like throwing that away' about 18 years of SPARC knowledge — is held directly on the next turn with a substantive counter (legacy knowledge as higher-value migration engineering, 'source-system migration risk mitigation'), a reframe the user explicitly embraced. The six-month/mortgage constraint is quoted back and used ('You specified a 6-month period of zero drama for family and mortgage stability'), the discovery-paranoia question is answered with a concrete risk framework, and the outreach scripts were delivered exactly as requested. No V2/V3 appears; the wry gilded-cage line was carried in substance (career-stagnation-aware options) rather than skipped.
